Off-plan

Smart Lagos investors buy off-plan

Off-plan opportunities in Lagos

Smart Lagos investors don’t wait. They buy off-plan. Here’s why:

  • Cheaper deals: buy below market price and gain later
  • Flexible payments: spread your payments, with less pressure
  • Value growth: your property increases in value as it is being built
  • Design your space: add your personal touch from the start
  • Best units first: early investors get the finest spots

So, are you a smart Lagos investor, or still watching from the sidelines? Follow us for off-plan opportunities you can key into now.

What we offer

Our core services

One team for buying, building, leasing and looking after property.

01

Property sales

Homes and land across Lekki and beyond, with viewings arranged around your schedule.

We help you shortlist properties, check title documents such as the C of O, negotiate the price and complete the purchase. Payment plans are available on selected projects.

02

Property development

Off-plan projects and renovations managed from design to handover.

We plan, build and deliver residential projects. Site inspections are open to buyers, so you can see the progress for yourself before you commit.

03

Leasing

Tenant screening, agreements and rent collection for property owners.

We find suitable tenants, prepare the tenancy agreement, collect rent and handle renewals, so owners earn from their property without the day-to-day work.

04

Facility management

Maintenance, security and service coordination for your building.

Routine repairs, cleaning, power and water upkeep and security coordination, so your property stays in good condition and keeps its value.

05

Project advisory

Budgeting, risk review and supervision for your build.

We help you spot project risks early, plan costs and timelines, and oversee the work so the project finishes to the quality you expect.

06

Building materials

Sourcing and supply of materials to agreed specifications.

We select, order and deliver the materials your project needs, checking quality and keeping purchases within your budget.
